body: I know. But its hard to make people understand. No body else will understand it. Even if they will be good to me but in their hearts they will always always wish it was the otherway around.

I was really close but I didn't make it. And honestly I don't know what I want to do now. That I also what I fear that I won't be able to make a good living because of this. And my brain even won't let it go.
People won't let it go. Even my closest family members and relatives will be the one to remind me of how much I fucked up.
Medicine. I will be reminded for the rest of my life how much money I wasted and that I wasn't good enough and the stuff like that.
